units.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: “He also says that you must not allow him to acquire frivolous ways. After wild merriment comes nothing but sorrow. Simple displays of joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure are merely signs of foolishness.”

paragraphs.source_en: Hearing such words only deepened Hirotada’s discomfort. “I understand. But if so many children suddenly fill the inner quarters, it will cause difficulties. When your child is old enough to walk, let him come and serve Takechiyo.”

paragraphs.source_en: Seated upon her bedding, Odai pondered the meaning of those words. Perhaps Shinpachirō had meant that it was precisely because Odai was carrying Takechiyo that the Mizuno house had refrained from joining the Oda clan, allowing the Matsudaira house to triumph in the Battle of Azukizaka. After Shinpachirō had left, Odai gently pressed her palms together without thinking. Everyone in the household rejoiced at Takechiyo’s birth.
